Ana R.: Heads-up: Priya (new hire) starts Mon 9am PT / 6pm CET and can't make our onsite I-9 window. Need an alternate plan.
Kai M.: Copy. Two options: virtual I-9 vendor (video + scanned docs) or local notary + courier. Both require preboarding forms complete by EOD Day 1.
Priya D.: I'm in Madrid. I can do virtual, but my Spanish passport scan is in Spanish. Do translations need to be certified?
Ana R.: For non-English docs, vendor accepts translated copies but prefer sworn translations for benefits/HR records. We can accept a notarized translation within 14 days.
Kai M.: Also note: benefits enrollment email has a 7-day window after activation. We can extend to 14 days for timezone/translation issues if recorded. Priya, want the extension?
Priya D.: Yes please apply 14-day benefits extension
